Callout.Name: Dog Loose - Schoolyard
Callout.Message: Dog loose in a schoolyard with children at play.
Callout.Advisory: Staff keeping children inside, dog still loose.

Script.Line: He got out when the gate was open for the deliveries.
He is not a bad dog. He is frightened of the children.
Do not run at him. Please do not run at him.

Lines.Approach: The children are inside and the dog is in the yard. Nobody has been bitten yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
